name: European Wildlife Comeback Fund
summary: Flexible funding for organisations in Europe whose keystone species reintroductions or population reinforcements are ready to go, with legal permits, animal source and landowner agreement in place.

amount.note: Per translocation; larger requests may be considered with strong justification.

status.quote: We welcome funding applications from organisations across Europe working to reintroduce keystone species or reinforce existing wildlife populations.

access.quote: We welcome funding applications from organisations across Europe working to reintroduce keystone species or reinforce existing wildlife populations.

amount.quote: The EWCF typically awards grants of up to 50,000 euros per translocation, although requests for larger amounts may be considered where there is a strong justification.

window.quote: If the above criteria apply to your initiative and your reintroduction or translocation is ready to go, then let us know!
